articles.headline: Kaden Honeycutt wins Craftsman 200 (Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Kaden Honeycutt won Craftsman 200 (Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P13 and leading 70 laps. Tyler Ankrum finished second and Dallas Underwood was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 4 cautions.

Ben Rhodes was the biggest mover, gaining 13 spots from P22 to P9.

Chandler Smith leads the championship with 966 points, 35 ahead of Dallas Underwood.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
